Walking the high passes

Read the field guide before you leave the trail, because the weather turns quickly above the tree line and the paths are not always marked.

A very long card title about crossing the northern pass in early spring when the snow is still deep

Recommended for experienced walkers
SnowRockGlacier walking

The pass is open from June to October. Walkers should carry warm clothes, enough water and a map, and tell someone where they are going before they start.

High pass
Elevation 4,200 metres above the sea
Range Northern ridge of the valley
First crossing By shepherds long ago

Most walkers cross the pass in one long day, starting before sunrise so that they reach the top before the afternoon clouds come in from the valley.
